id: 23_Chemical Spills & Exposures Mastering Laboratory Safety Emergency Protocols Trai
title: 化学品溢洒与接触的应急处置（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/23_Chemical Spills & Exposures Mastering Laboratory Safety Emergency Protocols Trai.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/23_Chemical Spills & Exposures Mastering Laboratory Safety Emergency Protocols Trai（国内版）/src.py

points.K7: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
points.K15: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
points.S1: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，身后有溢洒处理箱和洗眼器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a spill kit box and an eyewash station behind, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学品溢洒和接触怎么处置。
overlay: 化学品溢洒与接触的应急处置

shots.scene: 告知、围堵、处理、冲洗、就医五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a speech bubble, a barrier ring, a spill kit box, a water tap and a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 告知、围堵、处理、冲洗、就医。

shots.scene: 阿杰手一滑，一瓶空白标签的酸液倒在台面上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's hand slips and a bottle with a blank label and a corrosive warning sign tips over on the bench, spilling liquid.
shots.narration: 阿杰手一滑，一瓶酸洒在了台面上。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，伸手想用纸去擦
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes, then reaches for a roll of paper towels with a bare hand.
shots.narration: 他第一反应，是抓纸巾去擦。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意停下，指向溢洒处理箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to stop him and points at the spill kit box on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研喊住他：先别碰，按步骤来！

shots.scene: 小洒漏图标逐渐扩散变成大片
shots.prompt_en: A small spill icon spreading into a large puddle with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒很常见，可处理不当，小事变大事。

shots.scene: 酸、溶剂、粉末三种溢洒图标，各配不同工具
shots.prompt_en: Three spill icons: an acid puddle, a solvent puddle and a powder pile, each paired with a different cleanup tool icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同的化学品，处理方法不一样。

shots.scene: 小研翻看空白安全技术说明书的应急章节
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips open a blank safety data sheet to a page with spill icons.
shots.narration: 先看清是什么，查说明书再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰大声喊，周围同学转过头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls out loudly with a raised hand, and nearby students turn to look.
shots.narration: 第一步：大声告诉周围的人。

shots.scene: 无关同学沿箭头走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: Other students leave the lab along an arrow toward the exit sign.
shots.narration: 无关人员，先离开。

shots.scene: 吸附条围住溢洒，挡住流向
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent socks are placed in a ring around the spill, blocking it from spreading. No people.
shots.narration: 围住溢洒，别让它流开。

shots.scene: 门口挂上警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A warning sign is hung on the lab door to keep others out. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离现场，不让别人误入。

shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下溢洒处理箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes the spill kit box down from its wall mount.
shots.narration: 受过培训、经过授权，

shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服、戴上护目镜和耐化学手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat, chemical splash goggles and chemical-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 穿戴好防护，才用溢洒包处理。

shots.section_title: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
shots.scene: 溢洒上方飘起蒸气和颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Vapor and fine particles rise into the air above a spill. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒蒸气或病原飘到空气里，
overlay: 空气被污染时用呼吸器

shots.section_title: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
shots.scene: 呼吸器图标挡住飘来的颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A respirator icon blocking incoming vapor and particles with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 就需要呼吸防护。

shots.scene: 防毒面具配滤毒盒、防颗粒物口罩两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a half-face respirator with chemical cartridges, and a particulate filtering face mask. No people.
shots.narration: 化学蒸气用滤毒盒，病原颗粒用防颗粒物。

shots.scene: 面罩边缘漏气的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a loose respirator with air leaking around the edges, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴不严，等于没戴。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研做呼吸器适合性检验
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the seal of a respirator on the female graduate student during a fit check.
shots.narration: 用前要做适合性检验，确认贴合。

shots.scene: 打开的溢洒处理箱，里面的物品摊开
shots.prompt_en: An open spill kit with its contents laid out: neutralizer containers with blank labels, absorbent pads, gloves, goggles and waste bags. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒处理箱里，用品一应俱全。

shots.scene: 中和吸附剂从外向内撒在酸液上
shots.prompt_en: Neutralizing absorbent is sprinkled onto the acid spill from the outer edge toward the center. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碱溢洒，先用配套的中和剂。

shots.scene: 临时拿碱液去倒酸液的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pouring a strong base bottle onto an acid spill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别临时拿强酸强碱去互相中和。

shots.scene: 小研用吸附垫吸干，再用铲子收集
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student soaks up the residue with absorbent pads and scoops it with a plastic scoop.
shots.narration: 控制住后，用吸附垫吸收干净。

shots.scene: 废物装进贴空白标签的危险废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used pads and residue go into a sealed hazardous waste bag with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的材料，装袋贴签。

shots.scene: 倒进水槽和普通垃圾桶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pouring waste into a sink and throwing it into an ordinary trash can, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不倒下水道，不进普通垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 小研把废物袋送到危险废物暂存点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the sealed bag to the lab's hazardous waste collection point.
shots.narration: 按学校规程，交统一处置。

shots.scene: 液体溅到手臂和眼睛的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of liquid splashing onto a forearm and toward an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品溅到皮肤或眼睛，

shots.scene: 阿杰站在安全淋浴下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands under a safety shower with water pouring down, below a safety shower sign.
shots.narration: 马上去安全淋浴或洗眼器。

shots.scene: 流水不停，旁边计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: Water keeps flowing with a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 持续冲洗，时间要足，别提前停。

shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to a clinic building with a red cross sign.
shots.narration: 冲洗之后，立即就医。

shots.scene: 觉得不疼就算了的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person waving off a small burn and going back to work, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不疼也别拖，有的伤害会延迟出现。

shots.section_title: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
shots.scene: 安全技术说明书、标签、储存柜、应急电话四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a blank safety data sheet, a blank bottle label with a pictogram, a chemical storage cabinet and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉说明书，标签贴对，分类储存。
overlay: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急

shots.section_title: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
shots.scene: 王老师在培训课上讲解应急流程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains an emergency flowchart with icons to a group of students.
shots.narration: 出事怎么做，提前弄清楚。

shots.section_title: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理
shots.scene: 大片溢洒、骷髅图标、火焰图标、问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a large spill, a skull and crossbones, a flame and a question mark over an unlabeled bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 量大、剧毒、易燃、不明物，
overlay: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理

shots.section_title: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰撤出，关上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student out of the lab and closes the door.
shots.narration: 不要自己处理，立即撤离关门。

shots.section_title: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边报告图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her are icons of a lab, a department building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 这些溢洒，不要自己处理
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 阿杰在安全淋浴下，脱掉沾湿的实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands under the safety shower and takes off his soaked lab coat.
shots.narration: 大面积沾染，在淋浴下边冲边脱。

shots.scene: 污染衣物、鞋袜、手表装进袋子
shots.prompt_en: Contaminated clothing, shoes and a wristwatch are placed into a sealed bag. No people.
shots.narration: 污染的衣服鞋袜和饰物，都要去掉。

shots.scene: 洗眼器出水，手指撑开眼睑的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of fingers holding an eyelid open over an eyewash station with water jets. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼时，用手撑开眼睑。

shots.scene: 眼球转动的箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple eye diagram with circular arrows showing the eyeball rolling. No people.
shots.narration: 转动眼球，让水冲到每个角落。

shots.scene: 取下隐形眼镜的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a contact lens being removed from an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 戴隐形眼镜的，尽快取下。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白安全技术说明书和瓶子标签照片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank safety data sheet and a phone showing a photo of a blank bottle label.
shots.narration: 就医时，带上化学品的说明书或标签。

shots.scene: 小研在诊室门口向王老师说明情况
shots.prompt_en: At the clinic entrance, the female graduate student explains what happened to the safety administrator who has arrived.
shots.narration: 说清接触了什么、多久、怎么处理的。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现告知、围堵图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a speech bubble and a barrier ring.
shots.narration: 溢洒：告知、清场、围堵。

shots.scene: 防护用品和溢洒处理箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of goggles, gloves and a spill kit box. No people.
shots.narration: 受过训练，穿戴防护，再用溢洒包。

shots.scene: 撤离和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An evacuation arrow and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 量大剧毒不明物，撤离报告。

shots.scene: 淋浴和洗眼器、红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety shower, an eyewash station and a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到就冲，冲完就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a clean lab bench with a spill kit on the wall.
shots.narration: 临危不乱，按步处置，下次见！
